thread:
Marta (People Ops): Heads-up: several scorecards didn't sync to our analytics table overnight. Getting alerts from the hiring dashboard. Anyone seeing missing entries?
Eli (Recruiter): Yep I noticed 5 candidates in the UX loop with blank "overall" fields. I thought it was a GH export fluke.
Jon (Hiring Manager): That affected our debrief this morning. We had to pause the hiring committee until the numbers are restored.
QA (Recruiting Ops): I pulled the export logs. The sync job returned 200 but payloads truncated for interviews over 60min. Looks like the job times out while streaming long comment fields.
Marta (People Ops): Interesting. We recently increased the max comment length in the scorecard form. Could be the new length + export chunking.
DevOps Bot: :warning: Sync job 'ats-sync' average duration spiked from 12s -> 79s at 02:14 UTC. Error sample: "stream reset by peer"
Eli (Recruiter): Workaround: short-term can we strip long comments before the analytics ingest? We need scores for all candidates now.
QA (Recruiting Ops): I can add a sanitize step to the runner that truncates comments to 2k chars and retries. Will open a hotfix PR.
Marta (People Ops): Please also add an alert when >1% of interviews have empty numeric fields post-ingest. We should catch this earlier.
DevOps Bot: :rocket: Hotfix PR 1456 opened by QA. CI checks passing.
Jon (Hiring Manager): Thanks — once merged can someone re-run the past 24h sync and confirm the committee can resume?
Eli (Recruiter): I'll coordinate a manual re-run and ping the committee when done.
Marta (People Ops): Action items: 1) QA - merge hotfix to truncate long comments. 2) Dev - add threshold alert for empty numeric fields. 3) Eli - re-run sync and notify hiring committee.
DevOps Bot: :white_check_mark: Manual re-run completed. Missing scores recovered for 5 candidates.
